01-home.whatDiffers: The 'pressed JUICERY' wordmark is absent from the header and the circular leaf mark is absent from the footer; both render on live.
01-home.fixHint: Capture replaced them with a transparent 1x1 GIF — restore the real inline SVG via the icon registry.

01-home.whatDiffers: All headings/bold text render in Helvetica/Arial rather than the brand sans, visibly heavier and wider.
01-home.fixHint: Markup requests regola-neue-semibold/-medium/-regular but no @font-face declared them; self-host the real faces under those exact names.

01-home.whatDiffers: The black footer background stops mid-way through the copyright line, slicing it in half; the second legal line is not visible.
01-home.fixHint: Set the legal bar to height:auto with padding and remove the fixed height/overflow:hidden on the black footer container.

01-home.whatDiffers: Instagram, Facebook, X/Twitter and YouTube icons at the right of the legal bar are missing entirely.
01-home.fixHint: Restore the four social icon sources (blank 1x1 GIF placeholders) via the icon registry.

01-home.whatDiffers: The far-right shopping-bag icon is missing; only the account icon renders.
01-home.fixHint: Restore the 'Go to cart' icon source from the registry.

01-home.whatDiffers: The hero is a static poster image where live plays a looping video, and the pause control is an empty white circle.
01-home.fixHint: Replace the empty <mux-player> custom element with a real <video autoplay muted loop playsinline poster=...> and restore the pause glyph.

01-home.whatDiffers: The pill button label reads 'Join For' instead of 'Join For Free' — the word 'Free' is clipped.
01-home.fixHint: Remove the fixed width on the pill; use padding with white-space:nowrap.

01-home.whatDiffers: The prev/next/pause controls at the right edge of the promo bar are missing.
01-home.fixHint: Restore the three control icon sources from the registry.

01-home.whatDiffers: In the second product row, the card whose title wraps to three lines drops its price and CTA ~25px below its neighbours, breaking the shared baseline.
01-home.fixHint: Make each card display:flex; flex-direction:column; height:100% and push the price/CTA group down with margin-top:auto.

01-home.whatDiffers: Footer columns are ~70-90px narrower than live, wrapping 'Find a Store', 'Juice Cleanses', 'Member Terms and Conditions' and 'VIP Terms and Conditions' onto two lines.
01-home.fixHint: Widen the footer grid to the full container width and let the link columns size to content.

01-home.whatDiffers: Photos are scaled ~8-10% larger inside identically-sized frames, cropping subjects tighter than live.
01-home.fixHint: Match live's object-fit/aspect-ratio on the image frames instead of the upscaled background-size.

01-home.whatDiffers: Renders as a ~8px rounded rectangle where live uses a fully-rounded pill.
01-home.fixHint: Set border-radius: 9999px to match the other CTAs.

02-shop.whatDiffers: The clone has no footer at all on /shop — the page ends after the last product card with ~1450px of blank white, while live renders the full dark footer.
02-shop.fixHint: Ensure the footer partial renders on the shop route and remove the trailing whitespace.

02-shop.whatDiffers: The grid uses auto-fit so short sections stretch: Gift Cards (1 item) renders as a single ~1270px-wide tile, Supplements (2) as two ~600px tiles, versus a fixed 6-column ~166px card on live. Main cause of ~3300px extra page height.
02-shop.fixHint: Use grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(0,1fr)) with justify-items:start and pin the tile aspect-ratio.

02-shop.whatDiffers: Empty gap at header top-left where live shows the wordmark.
The sidebar shows only a 14-item Product Type list; the 'Gift Cards' row and the entire second 'Function' filter group are missing.
02-shop.fixHint: Render the full 26-chip taxonomy across both Product Type and Function groups.

02-shop.whatDiffers: Each filter row shows a ~4x18px solid dark bar where live shows a 20x20px outlined checkbox.
02-shop.fixHint: Restore the checkbox box model: appearance:none; width/height 20px; border:1.5px solid; flex:0 0 20px.

02-shop.whatDiffers: The shopping-bag icon right of the account icon is missing.
Within a row, price and quantity-stepper rows stagger by 20-40px depending on title wrap, where live aligns every row.
02-shop.fixHint: Card as flex column with min-height on the title block and margin-top:auto on the price/stepper group.

02-shop.whatDiffers: The sidebar is ~162px wide vs ~224px on live, wrapping the heading and long labels; the grid starts at x=267 instead of x=328.
02-shop.fixHint: Set the sidebar track to 224px with a ~72px column gap.

02-shop.whatDiffers: Product-card titles render bold where live is regular/medium at the same size.
02-shop.fixHint: Set the card title to the regular weight.

02-shop.whatDiffers: The 'Gift of Wellness' card shows only the title — the price block and 'Shop now' pill that live renders are absent.
02-shop.fixHint: Ensure the price + CTA block renders for gift-card products.

02-shop.whatDiffers: ~560px of empty white before the next heading where live has a ~90px section gap.
02-shop.fixHint: Remove the empty extra grid row / fixed min-height on that section wrapper.

03-our-journey.whatDiffers: The 476px-tall video embed renders as a completely blank off-white block — no poster, no play button, no iframe chrome.
03-our-journey.fixHint: Restore the embed in its 16:9 wrapper, or a static poster plus play-button overlay if third-party frames are stripped.

03-our-journey.whatDiffers: The page wrapper is capped at 1280px and left-aligned: the anchor-nav and hero run to x=1279 where live is full-bleed to 1439, leaving a 160px empty right strip.
03-our-journey.fixHint: Remove the max-width on the page wrapper; make hero and anchor-nav full-bleed and centre the inner text container.

03-our-journey.whatDiffers: The wordmark occupying x=49-169 on live is entirely absent; the header starts at the 'Shop' link.
Live breaks the h1 into three lines at ~980px; the clone stretches it to the full 1240px hero and breaks differently.
03-our-journey.fixHint: Add max-width:980px; margin-inline:auto to the hero h1.

03-our-journey.whatDiffers: The four social icons at the right of the legal bar are missing.
The circular leaf logo at the footer top-left is absent, leaving that grid cell empty.
Live shows account and bag icons; the clone drops the bag.
Footer columns end at x=1217 instead of 1376, wrapping four link labels onto two lines.
03-our-journey.fixHint: Widen the footer grid to the full container.

03-our-journey.whatDiffers: The four anchor links span 722px versus 610px on live — ~18% wider gaps.
03-our-journey.fixHint: Use flex with justify-content:center and a fixed gap instead of an evenly-distributed grid.

03-our-journey.whatDiffers: The photo is 7px taller than live at the same width.

04-locations.whatDiffers: The header top-left is empty where live shows the wordmark.
Every bold string renders at regular weight — headings, the Filters label and all footer column headings — while letterforms otherwise match.
04-locations.fixHint: The 600/700 brand faces were never declared; self-host regola-neue-semibold/-medium under the requested family names.

04-locations.whatDiffers: The map is 597px tall versus 693px on live (100vh minus header), the entire 100px page shortfall, clipping the store link row out of view.
04-locations.fixHint: Replace the fixed map height with calc(100vh - header) on the two-column wrapper.

04-locations.whatDiffers: The locator grid is capped at 1152px leaving a 225px empty right gutter; live is full-bleed with 64px padding.
04-locations.fixHint: Remove the max-width cap on the locator section wrapper.

04-locations.whatDiffers: Only the account icon renders; the bag icon is missing.
The circular leaf logo is missing from the footer top-left.
The four social icons are absent from the bottom bar.
Columns are compressed, forcing wraps that live does not have.
04-locations.fixHint: Drop the 1152px cap on the footer nav grid.

04-locations.whatDiffers: Zoom controls are empty white boxes with no +/- glyphs and the Google watermark is absent (map tiles are unpainted in BOTH captures, so the blank canvas itself is not clone-specific).
04-locations.fixHint: Third-party Google Maps chrome; documented as a known static-clone gap.

04-locations.whatDiffers: The map panel has a ~12px border-radius; live is square-cornered.
04-locations.fixHint: Set border-radius:0 on the map wrapper.

04-locations.whatDiffers: The prev/next/pause controls at the far right of the promo bar are missing.
The live screenshot's viewport is uniformly darkened to 75% brightness because a modal scrim was open during capture, so global colour deltas on this page are false positives.
04-locations.fixHint: No clone change; re-capture live with the modal dismissed before trusting colour diffs here.

05-flavor-quiz.whatDiffers: The entire quiz UI is absent — the lightbox iframe has no src, rendering an empty region between header and footer where live loads the embedded quiz form.
05-flavor-quiz.fixHint: Third-party lightbox embed; supply the embed URL or a static stand-in, and document as a known gap.

05-flavor-quiz.whatDiffers: The wordmark is the transparent 1x1 GIF placeholder and the sibling <source> has no srcSet.
Live renders the whole page at #BFBFBF because the quiz modal's 25% black scrim is open; the clone is pure white.
05-flavor-quiz.fixHint: Audit artifact plus the missing modal — colour deltas on this page are not independent defects.

05-flavor-quiz.whatDiffers: The shopping-bag icon is the 1x1 GIF placeholder.
The circular footer logo is the 1x1 GIF placeholder, leaving a blank 40px square.
All four social icons are invisible because the shared logo component hard-codes the 1x1 GIF for every item.
05-flavor-quiz.fixHint: Change the component to resolve its src from the icon registry by aria-label.

05-flavor-quiz.whatDiffers: Columns are ~70px narrower than live, forcing four labels onto two lines and the Membership paragraph to four lines.
05-flavor-quiz.fixHint: Replace the captured fixed pixel grid columns with minmax(0,1fr) and fixed px gaps.

05-flavor-quiz.whatDiffers: Every semibold heading renders at regular weight; markup asks for regola-neue-semibold which had no @font-face and fell back to sans-serif.
05-flavor-quiz.fixHint: Declare the missing faces under the requested family names.

05-flavor-quiz.whatDiffers: The prev/next/pause controls render the 1x1 GIF.
The registered mark renders at full body size rather than as a raised superscript.
05-flavor-quiz.fixHint: Restore the superscript styling on that glyph.

06-catering.whatDiffers: The wordmark is completely absent from the header; the left slot renders empty white.
The four social icons on the right of the legal bar are entirely missing.
The pill button label wraps onto two lines, inflating the button into a ~110px tall blob and pushing the page 44px taller.
06-catering.fixHint: Add white-space:nowrap and explicit horizontal padding with width:auto.

06-catering.whatDiffers: Columns are too narrow and shifted ~75px left, wrapping four labels onto two lines while ~200px of dead space sits at the right edge.
06-catering.fixHint: Match live's grid across the full content width.

06-catering.whatDiffers: The circular leaf logo at the footer top-left is missing entirely.
Only the account icon renders; the bag icon is missing.
All six 'Explore our menu' captions render bold versus regular/medium on live.
06-catering.fixHint: Set the caption weight to regular.

06-catering.whatDiffers: Footer headings render regular weight but are bold on live.
06-catering.fixHint: Apply the semibold face to the footer column headings.

06-catering.whatDiffers: The headline is heavier and ~4% wider than live.
The prev/next/pause controls at the right of the promo bar are absent.
The subhead is ~7px narrower and slightly lighter than live at the same size.
06-catering.fixHint: Match live's body size and letter-spacing.

07-membership.whatDiffers: Every benefit bullet is missing its filled check-circle icon; the clone renders indented plain text where live shows a black check badge.
07-membership.fixHint: Restore the check icon per list item with flex alignment.

07-membership.whatDiffers: The three cards are neither top-aligned nor equal-height: card 1's border starts 39px below its siblings and the 'Most Popular' banner is separated from card 2 by a ~19px white gap.
07-membership.fixHint: Use grid with align-items:stretch, attach the ribbon to the card, and give the price header a common min-height.

07-membership.whatDiffers: The clone falls back to Helvetica/Arial and loses heading weight across the page.
07-membership.fixHint: Self-host the brand faces under the requested family names.

07-membership.whatDiffers: 'Sign Up For Yearly' and 'Sign Up For Monthly' are stacked vertically and stretched full width versus two auto-width pills side by side on live.
07-membership.fixHint: Wrap in a flex row with width:auto buttons.

07-membership.whatDiffers: The heading wraps to four lines instead of two, pushing the section 58px taller than live.
07-membership.fixHint: Widen the text column and restore the heading weight and CTA margin.

07-membership.whatDiffers: Cards are 146x249px versus live's 113x196px, leaving ~90px of empty space below each label.
07-membership.fixHint: Constrain the card track width and min-height.

07-membership.whatDiffers: The tile grid stops at x=1250 versus x=1418 on live, leaving a ~168px empty right gutter.
07-membership.fixHint: Remove the max-width on the tile wrapper so tiles reach the container edge.

07-membership.whatDiffers: The bag icon is absent; only the person icon renders.
The four social icons on the right of the copyright bar are missing.
Columns are narrower and clustered left, wrapping four labels onto two lines.
07-membership.fixHint: Widen the footer grid to the full container.

07-membership.whatDiffers: The prev/next/pause control cluster is absent from the promo bar.
Card 1 floats 22px higher than its siblings and ends 11px short.
07-membership.fixHint: Apply the same stretch/ribbon-spacer fix as the main tier row.
